questions.q: Our designer ___ from home every Monday.
questions.explainRo: Our designer = he/she, deci verbul primește **-s**: works.

questions.q: Your flight is at quarter to seven. That's ___.
questions.explainRo: **Quarter to seven** = șapte fără un sfert, adică 6:45.

questions.q: It's eleven at night and I'm very tired. Time to ___!
questions.explainRo: Seara târziu, când ești obosit, mergi la culcare: **go to bed**.

questions.q: My wife ___ a yoga class at six.
Our tester ___ (go) home at four on Fridays.
After the gym, Radu ___ (take) a shower.
questions.explainRo: „A face duș” = **take a shower**; cu he/she/it verbul primește -s: **takes**.

questions.q: My client ___ (fly) to London every month.

questions.ro: Ședința începe la două și un sfert.
questions.explainRo: The meeting = it, deci **starts**; ora se spune cu **at**.

questions.ro: Tatăl meu ia micul dejun la șase și jumătate.
questions.explainRo: Cu he folosim **has breakfast**; 6:30 = **half past six**.

questions.audio: He checks his emails at nine.
answers: He checks his emails at nine.
He checks his e-mails at nine.
questions.ro: El își verifică e-mailurile la nouă.
Șeful meu ia prânzul la unu fără un sfert.
answers: My boss has lunch at quarter to one.
My boss has lunch at a quarter to one.
My boss has lunch at twelve forty-five.
My boss has lunch at twelve forty five.
My boss has his lunch at quarter to one.
My boss eats lunch at quarter to one.
My boss eats lunch at a quarter to one.
questions.explainRo: „A lua prânzul” = **have lunch**, iar cu he devine **has lunch**; 12:45 = **quarter to one**.
